title: Finite flat singleton fibre chart
statement: For a finite flat morphism f:X→Y of locally Noetherian schemes and x∈X, there exist locally Noetherian schemes Z,T, etale maps a:Z→X and b:T→Y, a finite flat map g:Z→T, and z∈Z such that af=gb, a(z)=x, z is the unique point over g(z), and for every w∈Z, g has an etale source neighbourhood at w if and only if f has one at a(w). No ramification or dimension assumption is required.

source.place: Tags 02LK and 0BJH, etale localization and invariance of the etale locus

proof.text: Finite f is locally quasi-finite, so the selected point is isolated in its fibre (Mathlib Scheme.Hom.quasiFiniteAt and QuasiFiniteAt.isClopen_singleton_asFiber). Apply exists_etale_finite_open_of_isolated_fiber_point to obtain an etale T over Y, an open V of the pullback, and z over x with a singleton fibre. Set Z=V, a=V.ι followed by pullback.fst and g=V.ι followed by pullback.snd. Base change and open restriction give Etale a and Flat g; finiteness is supplied by the theorem. LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian applied to b and a gives the Noetherian assertions. The pullback condition gives af=gb; the supplied uniqueness over t and g(z)=t give uniqueness over g(z).

For an etale source neighbourhood U for f at a(w), pull U back along a. The restriction of a is etale, so its composite with U.ι followed by f is etale. Rewrite this composite using af=gb and morphismRestrict_ι; cancel the etale b by Mathlib Etale.of_comp. This proves the corresponding neighbourhood assertion for g.

Conversely, let B be an etale source neighbourhood for g at w. The map e=B.ι followed by a is etale and e followed by f is etale by af=gb. Its open image U contains a(w). Factor e through U using IsOpenImmersion.lift, giving an etale surjective q:B→U. Smooth.of_comp_of_flat_of_surjective descends smoothness of the composite to U.ι followed by f. The fibre of the finite f is locally discrete: the open singleton of f.asFiber(a(w)) gives the upper bound zero in the infimum defining topologicalKrullDimAt, and every neighbourhood is nonempty, giving the lower bound zero. Apply exists_etale_open_of_smooth_of_fibre_dimension_zero to shrink U to an etale neighbourhood of a(w).

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_flat_singleton_fibre_chart
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [Flat f] (x : X) :
    ∃ (Z T : Scheme.{u}) (a : Z ⟶ X) (b : T ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ T) (z : Z),
      Etale a ∧ Etale b ∧ IsFinite g ∧ Flat g ∧
      IsLocallyNoetherian Z ∧ IsLocallyNoetherian T ∧
      a ≫ f = g ≫ b ∧ a z = x ∧
      (∀ w : Z, g w = g z → w = z) ∧
      (∀ w : Z, (∃ V : Z.Opens, w ∈ V ∧ Etale (V.ι ≫ g)) ↔
        ∃ V : X.Opens, a w ∈ V ∧ Etale (V.ι ≫ f))
